subject: Partner integration + co-sell — listing readiness and metering questions
messages:
From: Lauren Park <lauren@avacloud.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner listing + co-sell: Redwood integration and metering questions

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. AvaCloud is excited to pursue a GCP + AWS listing with Redwood and we want to align on two things up front: (1) technical evidence required for the marketplace listing and (2) the co-sell packaging / metering surface so our commercial teams can model ARR.

High-level on our side: we run a multi-tenant SaaS with OAuth2 SSO, we expose a metering endpoint that reports monthly usage, and we have a lightweight proxy for customer isolation. Attaching a simple architecture diagram (avacloud-integration-arch.png).

Questions:
- What specific artifacts does Redwood require for an ISV listing (evidence checklist, certs, telemetry examples)?
- Does the Redwood marketplace support per-customer metered billing via standard usage files or do you need an API push?
- Is there a co-sell enablement packet we should fill out to get Redwood GTM support?

We'd like to target an internal technical handoff on Nov 11 and a co-marketing plan before the end of the month if possible.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call.

— Lauren Park
Head of Partnerships, AvaCloud
lauren@avacloud.io

----

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Lauren Park <lauren@avacloud.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Partner listing + co-sell: Redwood integration and metering questions

Thanks Lauren — great to connect. Looping in Ben (sales) and Marissa (partnerships) so we can cover commercial and launch ops.

Quick answers and next steps:
- Evidence: we require a short bundle: architecture diagram, SSO integration notes, SOC2 or equivalent attestation (if you have it), a small security questionnaire, and at least one telemetry example showing token-level logs (we don't need production data; sanitized samples are fine). I'm attaching our marketplace-evidence-checklist.xlsx — it lists required docs and a recommended order for submission.
- Metering: Redwood supports both usage-file ingestion (S3 drop) and an API push model. For co-sell + billing automation we prefer API push if you can do it — smaller lead time. The spec you should follow is the Redwood Metering API v2 (I'll share the spec link in follow up).
- Co-sell packet: yes, we have a partner enablement packet that includes solution brief templates, GTM one-pager, sales play, and a short technical demo checklist. I will share the packet and a mutual action plan template.

Proposed timeline:
1) This week: exchange checklist + pricing sheet (Ben)
2) By Nov 9: partner provides evidence bundle + metering spec
3) Nov 11: technical handoff (eng-to-eng)
4) Nov 18: internal enablement + joint demo prep

Can you confirm who from your engineering team will be the contact (name + email) and whether you prefer API push or S3 drops?

Attachments: marketplace-evidence-checklist.xlsx

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
